title: Winter Heat
overview:
A parade of winter events.

Pick one of eight athletes, each with their own style, and go for new records across eleven winter sports events in five fields - Alpine, Sled, Nordic, Skate and New Wave. Speed and technique decide who becomes the champion of winter.

- Speed Skiing - race straight down the slope for the best time and top speed
- Ski Jumping - match your speed, takeoff angle and landing timing to fly past the K point
- Downhill - carve your edges through a varied alpine course
- Short Track Speed Skating - speed, blocking and cornering are the keys to victory
- Skeleton - steer a one-person sled with nothing but your body weight
- Slalom - weave through the gates in rhythm
- Aerial Skiing - put on a dazzling, dynamic show in the air
- Bobsleigh - pilot a steel sled at over 100 km/h
- Speed Skating - power down separate lanes like a bullet on ice
- Snowboarding - speed and action in a cool extreme sport
- Cross Country Skiing - pace your stamina over steep snowy hills

Up to four players can compete at once with the multi-terminal 6 adapter. Memory backup is supported.
